# Tropical Gardens Hotel Kyenjojo

> The best hotel in Kyenjojo, Uganda, offering comfortable rooms, a restaurant and bar, conference hall, garden events space, and secure online booking with Mobile Money and card payments via Pesapal. Located on Hoima Road, the main route between Kampala and Fort Portal in western Uganda.

Official website: https://tropicalgardenshotelkyenjojo.com/
Locations page: https://tropicalgardenshotelkyenjojo.com/locations.html
Menu PDF: https://tropicalgardenshotelkyenjojo.com/assets/tropical-gardens-menu.pdf

## Key Information

- Location: JJ9V+2V6, Hoima Road, Kyenjojo, Uganda (0.6187, 30.6447)
- Phone: +256 782 460683, +256 701 437896, +256 789 531470
- Email: tropicalgardenshotel@gmail.com
- Check-in: 2:00 PM | Check-out: 10:00 AM
- Reception: 24 hours
- Price range: UGX 80,000 - UGX 280,000

## Room Types

1. Standard Room - UGX 80,000/night - Free WiFi, en-suite, air conditioning
2. Deluxe Room - UGX 150,000/night - Spacious, premium amenities, work desk
3. Family Suite - UGX 280,000/night - Multiple beds, family-friendly, extra space

## Facilities

- Restaurant (Ugandan, African, Continental cuisine) - 7 AM to 10 PM daily
- Bar - 10 AM to 11 PM daily
- Conference hall (up to 200 guests)
- Garden events space (weddings, celebrations)
- Free WiFi and free parking
- 24-hour reception and room service
- Secure online booking with Pesapal (MTN Mobile Money, Airtel Money, cards)

## Nearby Attractions

- Fort Portal (45 km) - tourism capital of western Uganda
- Kibale National Park (75 km) - chimpanzee trekking
- Rwenzori Mountains - hiking and mountaineering
- Tea estates and crater lakes along the route
- Kampala to Kyenjojo: 290 km, 3-4 hour drive on Hoima Road
